ModMetaData.name: [MP] Mod compatibility for MP
ModMetaData.author: Compatibility Patch Maintainer
ModMetaData.description:
面向 RimWorld Multiplayer 的兼容补丁集合。
RJW（rim.job.world）兼容范围包括： - 同步深度交谈、双人性行为、自慰和束缚装备的右键动作； - 仅在同步命令中传输稳定的游戏引用和 Def； - 稳定无序集合上的随机目标选择； - 为婴儿特质继承使用确定性的 System.Random 种子； - 在部分第三方程序集无法完整反射时保护 RJW Attraction 初始化。
Multiplayer 是硬依赖。RJW、Meow Framework 和其他目标模组均按已加载类型 条件启用；未安装可选模组时，对应补丁会安全跳过。
English: Multiplayer compatibility patches with optional, runtime-resolved support for RimJobWorld and several mods in this collection. Includes synchronized UI/actions for Kiiro Story: Events Expanded and Ratkin Weapons+. Rigor Mortis 1.6 support includes mutant-ability commands resolved from Pawn_MutantTracker and real Custom Quest Framework option/action playback. Version 3.0.18 adds an opt-in MP-safe medium-priority alert UI throttle. It never throttles urgent alerts, forced removals, sync commands, or ultrafast simulation, and automatically falls back if another patch conflicts. Version 3.0.19 adds source-verified deterministic System.Random handling for Cumpilation 1.2.6 and RJW Genes 2.6.1, and synchronizes Cumpilation's seal and automatic-deflation gizmos while preventing UI-only state resets. Version 3.0.20 isolates RJW Sexperience pawn-generation randomization with a stable per-pawn seed during multiplayer, preserving its generated records and traits without advancing the surrounding synchronized map Rand stream. The same guard covers Sexperience's separate Nymph skill-randomization Postfix. It also isolates camera-local Verse.Rand use in Simple FX: Splashes 1.2.2, preserving rain flecks without contaminating the synchronized map Rand stream. RJW Core sex-part and Sized Apparel fallback initialization is likewise scoped during ExposeData, preventing Multiplayer timestamp diagnostics from consuming the live map Rand stream. Version 3.0.21 removes local CurrentMap fallbacks from runtime component and incident paths so peers viewing different colonies cannot select different maps. Version 3.0.22 prevents async simulation-only CurrentMap swaps from being sent as player VTR/view-map transitions. It also falls back to Multiplayer's vanilla per-map tick, Rand, and alert handling while async time is active. Version 3.0.23 extends those conservative fallbacks to every multiplayer session with more than one loaded map, including non-async newly founded colonies. This keeps local alert UI cadence, dynamic TickList initialization, and broad pawn Rand scopes from crossing Multiplayer's per-map lockstep boundary. Version 3.0.24 normalizes Hospitality's random social-interaction pawn list before its existing shuffle, so equal cross-PC map snapshots produce the same candidate permutation and consume the same weighted Rand path. It also normalizes RJW casual partner lists by stable pawn IDs before seeded attraction and partner selection. Version 3.0.32 rebuilds Multiplayer's runtime-only per-map TickLists from each map's authoritative spawned-Thing registry after a cold-join snapshot load. This targets Desync-44, where the host ticked Axolotl522 before Boomrat36358 while the joining client skipped directly to Boomrat36358 from the same map Rand state. Version 3.0.33 reconciles the TickList bucket about to execute against its owning map. It removes destroyed, unspawned, and cross-map stale members accumulated by a long-running host, targeting Desync-46 where only the host ticked Axolotl522 before returning to the cold client's otherwise matching entity sequence. Version 3.0.34 applies config-only host mismatches before world download without forcing a restart. Standard ModSettings are reloaded in place with callbacks, HugsLib setting handles are updated, host XML is restored verbatim after those callbacks, and client-only configs are reset with backups. Mod-list, file, and Def mismatches remain protected. Version 3.0.47 guards Vehicle Framework's caravan send prefix when Multiplayer's CaravanFormingProxy has no vehicle-aware dialog state, restoring pawns and item tabs and preventing the client-side null reference on caravan confirmation. Version 3.0.48 replaces Static Quality's process-time-seeded random source with a seed drawn from the synchronized Verse random stream during multiplayer. Version 3.0.49 restores spawned pawns missing from the normal TickList's current bucket after cold join, preserving the authoritative map tick membership. Version 3.0.50 narrowly recovers Multiplayer async-time's TickManager.Paused Postfix null reference during Pawn.PostMapInit before the map component is available. Other exceptions and normal async-time behavior remain unchanged. Version 3.0.51 prevents playing-state callbacks outside synchronized ticks, command playback, and reload from consuming positive simulation IDs. It uses Multiplayer's existing local negative-ID path and records the first newly covered caller, targeting the one-ID pawn-generation offset in Desync-72. Version 3.0.52 keeps Multiplayer's native caravan Cancel action visible when a colony is empty or only Vehicle Framework vehicle pawns remain. Cancellation still follows CaravanFormingSession.Cancel, removing the synchronized session and route planner instead of merely closing the local proxy window. Version 3.0.25 stabilizes RJW Menstruation pheromone target iteration before applying Hediffs. This prevents cross-PC AllPawnsSpawned insertion order from changing callback order and later map Rand consumption on dual-map sessions. Version 3.0.26 isolates RJWPE Voice Patch replacement randomness inside its cosmetic animation-sound callback. Local camera, audio, or animation playback can no longer advance Multiplayer's synchronized map Rand stream. Version 3.0.28 replaces Dubs Mint Menus' interface-based growing-plant sync with explicit map and stable zone/thing identifiers. This prevents a second plant-menu action in multi-map multiplayer from resolving its target as null or against the wrong colony. Version 3.0.29 restores stable Thing-ID order inside every Multiplayer per-map TickList after a cold join. It also replaces Nudity Matters More's process-local CanSeeNaked cache/Rand branch with a shared-day deterministic result in multiplayer, and prevents joining with mismatched host configs unless Multiplayer's authoritative Fix and Restart flow is used. Version 3.0.30 adds Perspective Shift multiplayer support. Each player may own a different avatar; ownership and movement input are server-ordered sync commands, movement uses deterministic RimWorld jobs, and local prediction is restricted to rendering/camera state without writing simulated Pawn positions. Version 3.0.31 replaces Perspective Shift's unsafe multi-slot drag storage window in multiplayer with deterministic direct deposit/pickup behavior. Version 3.0.61 resolves the real issuing player for Perspective Shift avatar claim/release commands, so host and clients retain separate local views and WASD input. Taking control also clears stale local camera-lock state. Version 3.0.62 prevents Multiplayer's command-context camera restoration from creating a Perspective Shift camera lock, narrows MP input blocking to real search/modal job states, and immediately replaces the initial Wait job when WASD movement begins. Version 3.0.63 brackets Multiplayer's deferred multifaction faction-creation body with an authoritative simulation scope, so faction identity, map generation, and InitNewGame no longer run as misclassified local callbacks (Desync-81). It also hardens config hot sync: unchanged records are skipped, changed keys are logged, and startup-bound XML Extensions changes block automatic continuation instead of faking a successful join. Version 3.0.64 makes season evaluation deterministic in multifaction sessions. Multiplayer's DateNotifier patch evaluates each peer under its own player faction, so season messages and the first-summer warning letter consumed shared message/letter IDs at different world ticks per peer (Desync-82, Desync-94). The notifier now runs under Multiplayer's spectator faction context and the real world tick counter on every peer. Version 3.0.66 restores Vehicle Framework's Vehicles tab as a read-only display inside Multiplayer's CaravanFormingProxy. The proxy still owns the Pawns/Items/Travel Supplies transfer widgets, while the vehicle cards are now visible with their cargo capacity and the proxy keeps its synchronized formation flow unchanged. Vehicle checkbox/sorter input stays disabled because VF's CaravanFormation.formation seat state is not owned by Multiplayer. Version 3.0.67 lets the synchronized Odyssey gravship takeoff allocate a positive shared world-object ID for the traveling Gravship. The previous unique-ID guard classified GravshipUtility.GenerateGravship as an unsynchronized playing-state callback and gave the Gravship a process-local negative ID, which Multiplayer's PlaceGravship sync cannot resolve reliably on the other peer after landing on a new map. The exemption is stack-narrow and leaves every other non-simulation allocation guard unchanged. Version 3.0.68 restores the DefensivePositions multiplayer compatibility layer whose own API-version check aborts before registering anything: assigning and clearing drafted-pawn defensive positions, squad reassignment, and advanced-mode toggles now run through synchronized commands instead of mutating only the clicking peer. It also isolates Milira Tale quest storyteller Rand probing from the synchronized world stream and fixes Elite Raid's two-argument ThreadSafeRandom overload registration. Version 3.0.69 synchronizes drafted SearchAndDestroy toggles by pawn ID so the other peer no longer depends on a local store-worker lookup that can be missing after a cold join (Desync-118/119). Version 3.0.70 makes natural-goodwill drift deterministic in multifaction by evaluating CheckReachNaturalGoodwill under Multiplayer's shared spectator faction, so goodwill changes and message IDs cannot advance on only one peer (Desync-121/122). Version 3.0.71 isolates Harbinger-tree CanFireNowSub world Rand with a deterministic seed derived from the target, def, and world tick (Desync-104, Desync-123). Version 3.0.72 adds a bounded caravan float-menu action-type diagnostic that logs the concrete CaravanArrivalAction type erased by the generic replay stack (Desync-126/127). Version 3.0.73 makes CaravansBattlefield victory settlement deterministic in multiplayer: it sends the victory letter and sets wonBattle without the per-peer FreeColonists RandomElement/TaleRecorder path (Desync-128). Version 3.0.74 guards the synced caravan float-menu replay against a null caravan argument: Settlement menu generation and SettlementVisitedNow no longer throw during replay, and a bounded [CaravanMenuGuard] log records the caravan-resolution state (Desync-129). Version 3.0.75 synchronizes the Tale of Milira leftover-supply dialog "leave" option so the letter and letter ID are created on every peer inside one command instead of only on the clicking peer (Desync-130). Version 3.0.76 exempts the synchronized gravship landing MapParent from the local negative-ID boundary guard, so the new colony map and settlement keep a positive shared world-object ID on every peer (gravship landing desync). Version 3.0.77 makes the Harbinger/special-tree CanFireNowSub eligibility probe unconditionally isolated in multiplayer, independent of the local performance gate, so a host/client setting mismatch cannot consume the live map stream on one peer (Desync-132). Version 3.0.78 wraps the vanilla work-site quest generation (QuestNode_Root_WorkSite.RunInt) in a deterministic Rand scope with the spectator faction context, keeping the new faction/site/leader IDs and Rand identical on both peers (Desync-133). Version 3.0.79 adds a bounded diagnostic for the techprint application path (job creation and ResearchManager.ApplyTechprint) to compare map/pawn/thing state across peers on the next bundle (Desync-134). Version 3.0.80 makes the Oberonia Aurea Birthday Wishes event deterministic: CheckBirthdayWishes, CanFireNowSub and TryExecuteWorker run under a deterministic Rand scope and the spectator faction context so RandomPlayerHomeMap and FreeColonists evaluate the same set on every peer (Desync-135). Version 3.0.81 wraps the storyteller random-quest burst (NaturalRandomQuestChooser.ChooseNaturalRandomQuest) in an unconditional deterministic Rand scope with the spectator faction context, so the large one-tick quest/incident evaluation batch consumes the same Rand on both peers (Desync-136). Version 3.0.87 completes the Odyssey gravship synchronized-ID boundary and adds bounded takeoff/landing lifecycle diagnostics. The Unique-ID guard now exempts the full gravship executor chain (InitiateTakeoff, RemoveGravshipFromMap, TakeoffEnded, AbandonMap, TravelTo, PlaceGravship, InitiateLanding, LandingEnded, BeginLanding, OnGravshipCaptureComplete, ArriveNewMap/ArriveExistingMap) and the caravan ambush attack-map MapParent path, so those long-event WorldObject allocations keep positive shared IDs instead of process-local negative IDs (Desync-146/147, wrong random state after landing). GRAVSHIP_TAKEOFF/TRAVEL/ ARRIVE_NEW_MAP/LANDING_ENDED logs are emitted at most three times each so the next bundle can pinpoint the stage where map/world Rand diverges. Version 3.0.88 pins the Insect Girls auto-spawn component tick (Kzi.GameComponent_InsectGirl.GameComponentTick) to Multiplayer's spectator faction context, so Find.RandomPlayerHomeMap and the spawned "kuoer" pawn register in the same map on every peer (Desync-151). Version 3.0.89 isolates RW Beheading's head-capture render (HeadCaptureUtility.TryCaptureHead) in a deterministic nested Rand scope, so the Unity Camera.Render / AlienRace / wound-overlay Rand drawn during damage or death ticks can no longer advance the live synchronized stream (Desync-150). Version 3.0.90 wraps the whole Storyteller.StorytellerTick interval burst in a deterministic Rand scope seeded from the world tick and current faction, so a one-tick refresh of many events consumes the same world Rand sequence on every peer even when the comp iteration differs (Desync-152, wrong random state for the world). Version 3.0.91 pins CaravanArrivalAction_Enter.Arrived to the caravan's player-faction context so colony arrivals make identical drop/draft/letter/enter decisions on every peer (Desync-153/154/155/156), and replaces StorageGroupUtility's link/unlink gizmo actions with primitive thing-ID MP commands to bypass the fragile official tuple/list serialization that failed during rejoin replay (Desync-157, IStorageGroupMember Sync Error). Version 3.0.92 disables the "厄兆噬树萌芽" (Harbinger tree sprout) event by skipping GameComponent_Anomaly.TrySpawnHarbingerTrees and IncidentWorker_HarbingerTreeSpawn.CanFireNowSub/TryExecuteWorker, per user request. The event can no longer be queued, selected, or executed, and its eligibility probing can no longer advance synchronized Rand. Version 3.0.93 isolates the remaining Blood Animations combat visual Rand callbacks in multiplayer (Pawn_Kill death spray, GenLeaving_DropFilthDueToDamage damage flecks, DamageWorker_AddInjury_ApplyToPawn injury spray, Bullet_Impact impact splashes) and makes Ideology date-triggered ritual obligations ("festivals") deterministic by ticking RitualObligationTrigger_Date under the owning ideo's faction context (Desync-162, Desync-163). Version 3.0.94 makes settlement trader stock regeneration deterministic from a stable per-settlement seed, runs GoodwillSituationManager.RecalculateAll under the shared spectator faction context so hostility-change letters and relations stay identical on both peers, and re-checks Milira-player faction relations every 1000 ticks so the "incorrectly hostile Milira" correction stays stable (Desync-166, Desync-167). Version 3.0.95 runs the canonical spawned-pawn inspiration check inside a deterministic per-pawn Rand scope so ritual ceremonies and other pawn-tick-order differences can no longer consume the synchronized map Rand on one peer only (Desync-168). Version 3.0.96 extends the existing stable pawn-ID/game-tick Rand boundary to async-time and multi-map multiplayer. Pawn TickInterval no longer bypasses that boundary when map TickLists execute in a different order after rejoin, preventing mental-break, interaction, health, and job-selection branches from advancing a later pawn's shared map Rand stream (Desync-176 through Desync-180).
